steps.text: Wake up, old timer.
Wet. Warm. Soft. The soil is flowing.
Silent. Gentle. Slow. The mind is sinking.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: Urgh...
Get up.
It'll get away.
The scorching moonlight pours down upon his skull. The soil beneath him seems to boil. The heat chases his fading consciousness out of the void. He opens his eyes to the stinging pain.
Yes. That's it. Stand up.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: How... how long have I been out?
Five minutes.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: Five minutes. I've wasted too much time.
One second can be the difference between life and death.
But this time, you have time.
Go to the lake. Retrieve your spear.
The hunter's spear—his companion, his lifeline—lies half-submerged in the lake.
He does not remember why he laid it down. It was akin to laying down his own life.
He pulls it out from the mud. The blood on its tip remains fresh.
You should wash your face. You've been chasing it for three days and three nights.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: Only three days. I'm not that old.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: Where did the beast run off to?
It's wounded. It can't have gone far. It must be licking its wounds in some corner of the forest.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: The forest...

a.text: He casts his gaze towards the forest.
The tree trunks reach upwards like spinal columns, with ribs spreading out like branches and countless slabs of meat hanging from them.
Dark fat piles up in the air, filled with sanguine fluids threatening to pour out at any moment.

steps.text: You're scared.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: Nonsense.
You're filled with doubt.
Doubt as to whether it's you moving forward, or the forest quickly approaching, with fangs bared.
You want to turn around and run.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: Impossible.
Don't try to hide it. I see it all.
But I'm not here to dispute your fear.
The forest is a monster. Everything about it is worth fearing.

spans.text: a monster. Everything about it is worth fearing.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: A monster...
A monster straight out of a nightmare, spreading its gaping jaws wide, tearing life to pieces. That's the true face of the forest.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: Yes, so it is.
But it is not undefeatable.
Do you remember the last you saw of me?

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: I do. I'll never forget.
Are you angry?

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: Yes, so angry that I'm trembling from head to toe, my nails digging deep into my palms.
Yes. Be angry. You need that anger.
You will feel fear, panic, and pain, but rage will wash it all away.
Nothing can stand in the path of your fury. Your wrath will sweep away the forest.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: Yes. I shall rage, pull the forest's fangs from its jaws, and cut off its claws.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: I will do to it what it did to you.
Good. There are blood trails over there. Take a look.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: Tch...

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: It's still warm. It bleeds. Its wounds have reopened.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: The trail stops here.
See the scratch marks on the trees? Observe carefully.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: I don't need you to tell me.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: The marks are deep. It must have clawed at it many times, ripping away the bark.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: At the edge of the marks are blood-soaked hairs. There are more on the ground.
These creatures are becoming more and more cunning.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: It knows the blood will give it away. It rubbed sawdust into its wounds to stop the bleeding, then cut the existing marks deeper to hide its trail.
But a beast is just a beast. A bar of graphite will leave its trail on paper, no matter how thin it is.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: The fruits of the cockleweed cling to the fur of passing animals, hitching a ride on them.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: Look at the path they have laid for us. Ha...

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: It entered that cave.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: What's that? I've never heard such a sound...
Looks like we have a new friend.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: The sound of its voice excites me. Could it be...?
Be patient. A hunter should stay focused on the quarry at hand.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: I know you're in there.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: Your wounds hurt. You're bleeding. Why won't licking stop it?

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: How does it feel to be the prey?

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: Do you remember the lives you tore apart with your claws and fangs? Did you ever imagine how they felt?

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: Now, you're just like me, tired and hungry. This is the end for both of us.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: There is nowhere to run. No choice but to fight.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: Ah, I understand now. Perhaps you need some stimulation.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: (Squeezes the sharp spear point, allowing the blood to flow down his arm)

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: Do you smell that? It's the scent of blood you love so much. The scent of life. You can't wait to bare your fangs at it.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: Kill me, and this body is yours to do with as you please.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: But can you manage it?

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: Brute! Still with such strength!

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: Blasted thing... Get your stinking mouth away from me!
Defeated so easily.
Look at you. How pathetic.
All that talk of killing the beast, yet here you are, powerless before it. Even as it lies wounded and near death.
Pounced on and torn apart like a rag. What a fitting end.
Have all those years of fighting done nothing temper you, Yoshitaka?

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: No... I'm not done yet.
You want to take it down with you.
I was an idiot to think you could.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: I can still...
No, you can't. You'll die here.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: I... won't...
Then raise your spear and stab it! Plunge it into its body!
One! Two!
Yes! That's it!
You need anger so hot you'll disregard your own life and everything else.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: Yes, for your sake, I need anger so hot I'll disregard everything else.
For my sake!
Kill it!
Yes, that's it.
Now stand.
Make it fear you.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: Shut up!

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: You! The claws and fangs of this terrible forest.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: Did you think you were a hair's breadth from killing me?

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: Did you think I'd given up?

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: I'm here! Come at me!

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: Kill me!
The hunting spear pierces the beast's throat, and the man's aging body falls to the ground.
A flash of lighting reveals a great shadow beneath the sky. Blazing flames slash through the dark clouds.
He trembles from head to toe, his nails digging deep into his palms.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: Yes, that's it. That must be it.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: A monster I've never seen before... So that's what left you in that state.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: Of course no ordinary beast could have bested you so easily. Of that I have no doubt.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: For you...

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: I will recite your name the moment my spear pierces its heart.
He closes his eyes.
